enriched_description: Large wolf of Arctic North America with distinctive white fur and a black-tipped tail. Coat is thick and dense with a soft undercoat and longer guard hairs, entirely white except for the black tail tip. Body is large, muscular, and well-proportioned with a deep chest and powerful legs adapted for Arctic conditions. Head is broad with a wide forehead and long muzzle. Ears are short, rounded, and erect. Tail is bushy and carried low with a distinctive black tip. Eyes are medium-sized, almond-shaped, and yellow or amber with an intense, alert expression. The breed's signature features include its pure white coat and black-tipped tail.

Medium-sized wolf with a distinctive reddish-grey coat living in southeastern North America. Coat is thick with a soft undercoat and longer guard hairs, ranging from reddish-brown to grey with cinnamon tones along the back and sides. Body is lean, muscular, and intermediate in size between a coyote and a grey wolf. Head is broad with a wide forehead and long, narrow muzzle. Ears are large, pointed, and erect. Tail is bushy and carried low. Eyes are medium-sized, almond-shaped, and amber with an intense, alert expression. The breed's signature features include its reddish-grey coloration and intermediate size.

Small wolf native to western North America with a greyish-brown coat. Coat is thick with a soft undercoat and longer guard hairs, ranging from grey to brown with a lighter underside and darker back. Body is lean, slender, and well-proportioned with a deep chest and long legs. Head is narrow with a broad forehead and long, pointed muzzle. Ears are large, pointed, and erect. Tail is bushy and carried low with a black tip. Eyes are medium-sized, almond-shaped, and yellow with an intense, alert expression. The breed's signature features include its small size, pointed ears, and bushy tail with black tip.

Wolf-like wild dog of Australia with a yellowish-brown coat. Coat is short, dense, and weather-resistant in shades of ginger, tan, or reddish-brown with white markings on chest, feet, and tail tip. Body is lean, muscular, and well-proportioned with a deep chest and long legs. Head is broad with a flat skull and long muzzle. Ears are erect, pointed, and set high. Tail is bushy and carried low with a slight upward curve. Eyes are medium-sized, almond-shaped, and dark with an alert, intelligent expression. The breed's signature features include its yellowish-brown coat, erect ears, and wild dog heritage.

Fierce wild dog of central and southeast Asian forests with a reddish-brown coat. Coat is short, dense, and coarse in shades of reddish-brown to tawny with a lighter underside. Body is lean, muscular, and well-proportioned with a deep chest and long legs. Head is broad with a flat skull and short, broad muzzle. Ears are large, rounded, and erect. Tail is bushy and carried low with a black tip. Eyes are medium-sized, almond-shaped, and dark with an intense, alert expression. The breed's signature features include its reddish-brown coat, large rounded ears, and pack-hunting behavior.

Powerful doglike mammal of southern and eastern Africa with a distinctive mottled coat of black, brown, white, and yellow patches. Coat is short, sparse, and irregularly patterned with unique markings for each individual. Body is lean, muscular, and well-proportioned with long legs and a deep chest. Head is broad with a flat skull and long muzzle. Ears are large, rounded, and erect. Tail is long, bushy, and white-tipped. Eyes are medium-sized, almond-shaped, and dark with an alert, intelligent expression. The breed's signature features include its distinctive mottled coat pattern, large rounded ears, and pack-hunting behavior.

Doglike nocturnal mammal of Africa and southern Asia with a coarse, shaggy coat in greyish-brown with dark spots or stripes. Coat is thick and coarse with a distinctive mane along the back and neck. Body is powerful, well-muscled, and slightly longer than tall with a sloping back (higher at shoulders than hips). Head is broad and massive with a powerful jaw and strong muzzle. Ears are large, rounded, and erect. Tail is short, bushy, and carried low. Eyes are medium-sized, almond-shaped, and dark with an alert expression. The breed's signature features include its sloping back, powerful jaws, and distinctive spotted coat.

Common Old World fox with a distinctive reddish-brown coat. Coat is thick and dense with a soft undercoat and longer guard hairs, reddish-brown on the back and sides with a white underside and black legs. Body is lean, muscular, and well-proportioned with a deep chest and long legs. Head is narrow with a broad forehead and long, pointed muzzle. Ears are large, pointed, and erect with black backs. Tail is long, bushy, and white-tipped. Eyes are medium-sized, almond-shaped, and amber with an alert, intelligent expression. The breed's signature features include its reddish-brown coat, black legs, and bushy white-tipped tail.

Small grey fox of southwestern United States with a distinctive grey coat. Coat is short, fine, and soft in shades of grey to silver-grey with a lighter underside and buff or orange tones on the back. Body is small, slender, and well-proportioned with long legs and a narrow chest. Head is narrow with a broad forehead and long, pointed muzzle. Ears are very large, pointed, and erect, disproportionately large for the body size. Tail is long, bushy, and black-tipped. Eyes are medium-sized, almond-shaped, and dark with an alert, intelligent expression. The breed's signature features include its small size, large ears, and grey coat.

Thickly-furred fox of Arctic regions with a distinctive seasonal coat change. Winter coat is dense, fluffy, and pure white for camouflage in snow. Summer coat is brownish-grey or dark grey. Coat is extremely thick with a soft undercoat and longer guard hairs. Body is small, compact, and well-proportioned with short legs and a rounded body. Head is broad with a short muzzle. Ears are small, rounded, and erect, shorter than other fox species. Tail is long, bushy, and carried low. Eyes are medium-sized, almond-shaped, and dark with an alert expression. The breed's signature features include its seasonal color change and extremely thick winter coat.
